title: Brick by Brick
author: 18Wheeler
desc: A full body program with additional arms day. Target for beginner and novice. Very good for lifter that is up for a challenge. Recommended training spilt Monday,  Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday. Rest after every full body training session.
